definition: the light and rays of the sun
description: A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.
